hint.text: The orange words are fine, but the synonyms improve the sentences. Synonyms can be helpful when writing longer texts so that you don’t always repeat the same word. It is also useful when you want to describe something more precisely, or in a more interesting way.

instruction.text: Match each sentence with a synonym to replace the orange word.

atoms.a: The view from our window is nice.
atoms.sound: The view from our window is lovely.

atoms.a: His new designs are really different, I’ve never seen anything like it before.
atoms.sound: His new designs are really unique, I’ve never seen anything like it before.

instruction.text: Match each sentence with a synonym to replace the orange word.

atoms.a: We went to the supermarket before it closed.
atoms.sound: We rushed to the supermarket before it closed.

atoms.a: The play we saw last week was so good that I’ve recommended it to everyone.
atoms.sound: The play we saw last week was so enjoyable that I’ve recommended it to everyone.

instruction.text: Choose the correct synonym to replace the orange word.

atoms.a: I saw your friend the other day, we both waved when we saw each other!
We had to ask the person working at reception for directions, who then said what to look out for.
My brother wanted to show his friend his pet guinea pigs, but they went back into their hutch when he arrived.

atoms.sound: I smiled at my friend and he beamed back at me.
I jumped down from the step and my cat sprung after me.
My sister ran for the bus and I sprinted after her.
It’s fun to sing along to music in the car, and belt out your favourite lyrics.
